device: Pixel 7a, native Chrome, API 37; 411x789 CSS, DPR 2.625
limits: Fresh generated seed-2026 city, not the owner saved depot. One native horizontal-route car is replaced one-for-one by compact-1; later movement uses ordinary native touch input.
The out-and-back fixture reverses held direction at about 20 sample seconds. It traverses fresh then revisited terrain and retains a different traffic workload from an uninterrupted straight route.

Callback intervals and inclusive CPU elapsed timers are not displayed-frame, hardware GPU, battery-power or long-term thermal capacity measurements. Device background activity is not globally controlled.
CPU sampling, render census and tracing are separate attribution lanes; do not compare their timing to clean controls as before/after gains.
No production renderer, simulation, ordering, shader or art changes in this slice.
GPU-process trace aggregates include other hidden browser targets. Main-thread trace events belong to the owned page. GPU/raster overlap is correlation; source-specific tags are still needed.

motion.method: Net position change in approximately one-second intervals; >1px counts a moving interval. Subsecond stops and curved path length are unresolved.
